sources.snippet: Overview Huihui-gemma-4-E2B-it-abliterated is an uncensored variant of Google's Gemma 4 2B instruction-tuned model created by huihui-ai using abliteration techniques to remove refusal mechanisms. The model runs on the Transformers library and is available via Ollama for easy local deployment.
